_source: Step 0 of ab_memory_evolution_direction_20260710 — synthesis eval set (the measured 62%-miss class: NL queries answered by a SET of rows, no single gold, so R@k/MRR are undefined). Hand-curated 2026-07-12, NOT auto-derived from used_at. Gold-SET recall scoring (see A.3 of the recon draft). All gold keys re-verified status=active 2026-07-12 via read-only DB (mode=ro).
_scoring: set_recall — per query: set_recall@k = |gold_set ∩ top_k| / |gold_set| (report @10 and @20); primary_hit@5 = 1 iff every `primaries` key appears in top-5. Modes fts/hybrid/semantic + any_mode. any_mode is the per-gold-key UNION across modes (a gold key counts as retrieved@k if AT LEAST ONE mode ranks it ≤ k; primary_hit@5 counts a primary hit if it is top-5 in ANY mode) — the faithful set generalization of retrieval_pairs any_mode (best-rank-per-key). This is the most favorable of the honest interpretations: if even the union of all three modes misses, the workload is genuinely under-served.
